column2: - do NOT put --project-dir here, run_batch.sh supplies it
- names must be unique; two entries with the same name would share state
- '#' comments and blank lines are ignored
The order is deliberate. With JOBS=4 the first four entries take the GPUs
immediately, and 5x1-108 is the smallest system (43k particles) - that is
where the pipeline should be validated, not on 5x116-347 with its 438k.
5x116-347 re-activated 2026-09-16. It was suspended over three defects, all
silent - none raised an error, all falsified the result:
--packmol-radius-A 50 -> 11: inside a Packmol structure block that value
is the radius of EVERY atom, so it forced 100 A between beads of
different copies, and on a 464-residue dimer Packmol never converged.
--elastic-units rewritten by adding 115: martinize2 reads -eunit as PDB
residue numbers, and 116-347_1.pdb is numbered 116-347. The values in
construct-local numbering produced 653 springs instead of 1320, leaving
coils 2A and 2B with no elastic network at all.
--martini-lambda-pw 1.10 added: it uses TC6, which no other construct
uses and which the previous lambda file did not rescale.
Checked on the bond graph: both dimers are ONE connected body (126
inter-chain bonds in 1-263, 164 in 116-347). The two bondless beads in
116-347 are the virtual sites of TRP295's SC3, which have none by design.
